description.value: The Dining Commons is Capilano University's main on-campus cafeteria in North Vancouver, housed in a two-storey building serving the university community. It is listed under CapU's student services as the primary food and dining destination on campus. Cyclists in the North Shore area may find it a convenient stop given its location on an established university campus.
